title: Why We Built Popcorn: An Attestable Browser Cloud for Reclaim
excerpt: How Reclaim went from running verification on phones to building Popcorn: a fast, mobile-native browser cloud that runs inside trusted execution environments.
content_html:
Abdul Rashid Reshamwala

Aug 5, 2026

engineeringpopcornTEE

Reclaim lets people prove facts about themselves from websites they already use. Popcorn is the attestable browser cloud we built to make those proofs easier to integrate. Users complete the flow in a live, mobile-native browser running inside a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Popcorn generates the proof, then destroys the session. You can try Popcorn or explore the code on GitHub.

In the latest 30-day window, Popcorn created 102,859 browser sessions and allocated ready browsers in 470 ms at p50 and 889 ms at p95.

The story began with a WebView on the user's phone. That approach kept the work close to the user, but it asked every app integrating Reclaim to carry a surprising amount of infrastructure in its pocket: native cryptography, WebView orchestration, proof generation, and platform-specific glue. We rebuilt our proof-generation engine and cut proof time from roughly 40 seconds to 4–5 seconds, but the integration was still substantial. That migration is a story of its own.

The performance problem had improved. The integration problem had not.

We built both an App Clip and an Android Instant App to avoid a full SDK integration. They worked, but partners did not want verification to send users into a separate app experience. Google Play Instant was eventually discontinued. We needed an integration that stayed inside the product flow without putting the full browser and proof workload on the phone.

The product idea sounded almost suspiciously simple: open a browser remotely, stream its live view to the user, let them sign in and navigate, then generate the proof. Moving the work off the phone, however, also moves the hardest part of the trust model into our infrastructure.

Starting with Kernel

We evaluated Browserbase and other hosted-browser platforms. Kernel worked best for our flows, especially because we needed headful browsers.

Users needed to operate a real, visible Chrome session. Some sites behave differently in headless mode, while some login flows block automation. Kernel gave us interactive Chrome sessions, a live view, and browser-control APIs we could build on.

Kernel got us to a working product quickly. Another important point was that its browser image was open source. We could inspect the image, make the changes our flows needed, and contribute useful fixes upstream, including parent-frame status events and a video-sync anti-echo fix.

Once the remote-browser experience worked, the harder question became where that browser could safely run.

Kernel did not have plans to support the hardware-backed security model we needed. That meant the browser had to run on infrastructure we controlled. We started building our own TEE-based deployment, using Kernel's open-source browser image as the base instead of rebuilding a headful Chromium container from scratch.

The browser still had to be trusted

Browser sessions handle credentials, cookies, and private account data. Encryption protects that data while it travels across the network and while it is stored, but not while the browser is actively using it. Inside an ordinary VM, the host can still access that memory.

A Trusted Execution Environment, or TEE, gave us the missing protection. It is designed to isolate the browser's memory from the rest of the host, including the surrounding cloud infrastructure.

Result: memory not found. Dignity also missing.It cannot directly inspect the TEE-protected browser memory.

A TEE does not hide the page from the browser; the browser still needs to render it and generate the proof. It protects that work from the surrounding host. In production, each browser runs on a Confidential GKE Node with a small attestor service beside it.

In simple terms, a verifier can check that the session ran on genuine confidential hardware and used approved code. It does not have to take our word that the server was configured correctly.

Here is how it works in production. The verifier sends the attestor a fresh nonce, or one-time random challenge. The attestor returns a response tied to that challenge, the cryptographic fingerprints of the browser and attestor images, and a Google Cloud hardware attestation.

A TEE still does not replace TLS, authentication, authorization, or code review; it narrows what must be trusted.

This was not a security feature we could bolt on after the browser worked. TEE availability now determined where we could run Popcorn.

We first self-hosted on AWS with AMD SEV-SNP, but too few nearby regions supported it. Google Cloud offered AMD SEV-backed Confidential VMs and Confidential GKE in more of the regions we needed, so we moved the fleet.

The browser was only half the system

At this point, we had a browser image that could run inside a TEE. But an image is not a browser cloud. We still needed a system that could:

  • keep isolated browsers ready before users asked for them;
  • route each request to a nearby, healthy region;
  • connect the user securely to the assigned browser; and
  • replace used browsers, add TEE machines when needed, and clean up finished sessions.

We split the work across a few focused components. The control plane authenticates the request and selects a region. A pool manager in that region assigns a ready browser, while the gateway securely carries the live view between the user and that browser. The control plane coordinates the session without sitting in the streaming path.

Agones is an open-source system for managing fleets of multiplayer game servers on Kubernetes. That sounds unrelated until you look at the lifecycle. A browser waits for a user, belongs to that user for a short session, and is then discarded. Agones already knows how to manage that pattern.

Each regional pool keeps a warm buffer of browsers that are already running and marked Ready. A request only needs to claim one, so scheduling, image pulls, and browser startup stay off the user-facing path. Agones tracks each browser from waiting to assigned to finished. When one is assigned, its FleetAutoscaler starts a replacement. If the current TEE machines are full, our node prescaler adds another machine.

The flow is simple: a user starts a session, and the control plane chooses a pool close to them. Each regional pool contains several TEE nodes, and each node runs many isolated browser pods. The pool manager asks Agones for a ready browser and returns signed connection details. The live view then travels through the regional gateway directly to that browser. Behind the scenes, the scalers replace the assigned pod and add another TEE node when the pool needs more room.

Together, these pieces gave us a repeatable way to bring up a secure browser cluster in a new region, keep browsers ready, and serve users from a location close to them.

Owning the experience

Once the secure regional fleet was running, our focus shifted from where the browser ran to how it felt. Phones and slow networks exposed rough edges in the live stream, runtime, and viewer. We worked through them one by one.

From WebRTC to VNC

The first major change was the live view. In our iOS testing, Low Power Mode sometimes prevented the remote video from autoplaying, while backgrounding the app could lead to slow ICE reconnection. Some mobile and corporate networks also blocked or degraded WebRTC's preferred UDP paths. TURN, including relay over TCP, improved reachability but added another network hop and, in our measurements, more latency.

We replaced the WebRTC video stream with VNC's Remote Framebuffer protocol, carried over a secure WebSocket and rendered with noVNC. RFB represents display updates as rectangles, which suited our mostly static verification pages: users often pause to read or type, so the display changes only intermittently. This is a workload-specific trade-off; WebRTC remains better suited to high-motion content.

For Popcorn, the change reduced the live-view path to one WebSocket connection, shortened recovery after app switches, and produced more predictable behavior on slow mobile and corporate networks.

A smaller image for a narrower job

Changing the transport exposed another problem: the runtime carried far more than our live-view path needed. It still depended on the Kernel Images API and the Neko/WebRTC runtime, along with the supporting machinery around them. That made browser startup, image builds, and our development loop slower.

So we rebuilt the runtime image from scratch around one job: running Popcorn's LiveView in production. The new image contains the browser, lightweight desktop, VNC/noVNC viewer, Reclaim proof endpoint, proxying, and attestation. It no longer depends on the Kernel Images API or the Neko/WebRTC runtime.

These are internal before-and-after measurements for the runtime image, separate from the request-to-allocation latency discussed later. The smaller stack also gave us a cleaner build loop and much less software to operate.

Running the mobile gauntlet

Most Reclaim sessions happen on phones. The viewers we tested could show a desktop browser on a small screen, but we wanted Popcorn to feel like a native mobile browser.

Typing had to feel immediate. Zoom had to follow your fingers. Prompts and forms had to fit the screen, and switching apps could not lose the session. We built those behaviors into the viewer itself.

Popcorn now owns the mobile experience. Integrators get native-feeling typing, zoom, gestures, dialogs, and reconnection without rebuilding them inside their app.

What it looks like in production

By August 5, 2026, Popcorn had moved well beyond a prototype. Over the previous 30 days, the fleet created 102,859 sessions and ended 102,809. Those sessions accounted for 10,605 hours and 11 minutes of browser time, with an average lifetime of 6 minutes 11 seconds. The fleet handled an average of 2.38 new sessions per minute.

The speed users feel first is allocation. We measure it from the moment the control plane receives a request until the regional pool manager returns the signed connection details for an assigned browser. That took 470 ms at p50 and 889 ms at p95.

On provisioned capacity, the minimal image can start a fresh browser pod in roughly 2–3 seconds. Once the cloud prerequisites are available, we can bring an entire regional Popcorn cluster to Ready in roughly 20 minutes. That lets us add capacity close to users wherever compatible TEE infrastructure is available.

What we learned

Start managed. Fork when the requirements sharpen. Specialize after learning.

The path to Popcorn was not “build versus buy.” Using Kernel let us validate the product before building browser infrastructure. Forking its open-source image taught us which parts of the stack mattered. Operating that fork exposed the limits of a general-purpose image for our workload. Only then did a minimal image, a mobile-native viewer, and our own scaler become the sensible choice.

Let real constraints choose the technology.

Cloud regions, mobile networks, and phone keyboards chose more of this architecture than fashion did. Each change came from watching the verification flow fail under a real constraint, then fixing that constraint at the layer that owned it.

Security becomes infrastructure topology.

Once every browser must run inside a TEE, confidential-computing availability becomes part of scheduling. It shapes cloud selection, regional expansion, node pools, images, attestation, capacity planning, and failure handling. A security requirement no longer stays in the security layer.

Popcorn now gives apps a much lighter way to integrate Reclaim while keeping the sensitive browser workload inside an attestable environment. It took a hosted service, an open-source fork, a cloud migration, a new streaming path, and an unreasonable amount of attention to mobile keyboards to get there. The runtime image, fleet configuration, attestation design, and full repository are open source.

Try Popcorn or start with the repository.

sentences.en: We built both an App Clip and an Android Instant App to avoid a full SDK integration.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了 App Clip 和 Android Instant App，以避免完整的 SDK 集成。

sentences.en: They worked, but partners did not want verification to send users into a separate app experience.
sentences.zh: 它们有效，但合作伙伴不希望验证将用户带入单独的应用程序体验。

sentences.en: Google Play Instant was eventually discontinued.
sentences.zh: Google Play Instant 最终被终止。

sentences.en: We needed an integration that stayed inside the product flow without putting the full browser and proof workload on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一种留在产品流程内部的集成，而不需要将完整的浏览器和证明工作负载放在手机上。

blocks.html_en: The product idea sounded almost suspiciously simple: open a browser remotely, stream its live view to the user, let them sign in and navigate, then generate the proof. Moving the work off the phone, however, also moves the hardest part of the trust model into our infrastructure.

sentences.en: The product idea sounded almost suspiciously simple: open a browser remotely, stream its live view to the user, let them sign in and navigate, then generate the proof.
sentences.zh: 该产品的想法听起来几乎简单得令人怀疑：远程打开浏览器，将其实时视图传输给用户，让他们登录并导航，然后生成证明。

sentences.en: Moving the work off the phone, however, also moves the hardest part of the trust model into our infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 然而，将工作从电话上转移出去也会将信任模型中最困难的部分转移到我们的基础设施中。

sentences.en: Starting with Kernel
sentences.zh: 从内核开始

blocks.html_en: We evaluated Browserbase and other hosted-browser platforms. Kernel worked best for our flows, especially because we needed headful browsers.

sentences.en: We evaluated Browserbase and other hosted-browser platforms.
sentences.zh: 我们评估了 Browserbase 和其他托管浏览器平台。

sentences.en: Kernel worked best for our flows, especially because we needed headful browsers.
sentences.zh: 内核最适合我们的流程，特别是因为我们需要有头浏览器。

blocks.html_en: Users needed to operate a real, visible Chrome session. Some sites behave differently in headless mode, while some login flows block automation. Kernel gave us interactive Chrome sessions, a live view, and browser-control APIs we could build on.

sentences.en: Users needed to operate a real, visible Chrome session.
sentences.zh: 用户需要操作真实、可见的 Chrome 会话。

sentences.en: Some sites behave differently in headless mode, while some login flows block automation.
sentences.zh: 有些网站在无头模式下的行为有所不同，而有些登录流程会阻止自动化。

sentences.en: Kernel gave us interactive Chrome sessions, a live view, and browser-control APIs we could build on.
sentences.zh: 内核为我们提供了交互式 Chrome 会话、实时视图以及我们可以构建的浏览器控制 API。

blocks.html_en: Kernel got us to a working product quickly. Another important point was that its browser image was open source. We could inspect the image, make the changes our flows needed, and contribute useful fixes upstream, including parent-frame status events and a video-sync anti-echo fix.

sentences.en: Kernel got us to a working product quickly.
sentences.zh: 内核很快就让我们得到了一个可以工作的产品。

sentences.en: Another important point was that its browser image was open source.
sentences.zh: 另一个重要的一点是它的浏览器图像是开源的。

sentences.en: We could inspect the image, make the changes our flows needed, and contribute useful fixes upstream, including parent-frame status events and a video-sync anti-echo fix.
sentences.zh: 我们可以检查图像，进行所需的流程更改，并向上游提供有用的修复，包括父帧状态事件和视频同步反回声修复。

blocks.html_en: Once the remote-browser experience worked, the harder question became where that browser could safely run.

sentences.en: Once the remote-browser experience worked, the harder question became where that browser could safely run.
sentences.zh: 一旦远程浏览器体验发挥作用，更困难的问题就变成了浏览器可以在哪里安全运行。

blocks.html_en: Kernel did not have plans to support the hardware-backed security model we needed. That meant the browser had to run on infrastructure we controlled. We started building our own TEE-based deployment, using Kernel's open-source browser image as the base instead of rebuilding a headful Chromium container from scratch.

sentences.en: Kernel did not have plans to support the hardware-backed security model we needed.
sentences.zh: 内核没有计划支持我们所需的硬件支持的安全模型。

sentences.en: That meant the browser had to run on infrastructure we controlled.
sentences.zh: 这意味着浏览器必须在我们控制的基础设施上运行。

sentences.en: We started building our own TEE-based deployment, using Kernel's open-source browser image as the base instead of rebuilding a headful Chromium container from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我们开始构建自己的基于 TEE 的部署，使用 Kernel 的开源浏览器映像作为基础，而不是从头开始重建一个 headful Chromium 容器。

blocks.html_en: The browser still had to be trusted

sentences.en: The browser still had to be trusted
sentences.zh: 浏览器仍然必须被信任

blocks.html_en: Browser sessions handle credentials, cookies, and private account data. Encryption protects that data while it travels across the network and while it is stored, but not while the browser is actively using it. Inside an ordinary VM, the host can still access that memory.

sentences.en: Browser sessions handle credentials, cookies, and private account data.
sentences.zh: 浏览器会话处理凭据、cookie 和私人帐户数据。

sentences.en: Encryption protects that data while it travels across the network and while it is stored, but not while the browser is actively using it.
sentences.zh: 加密可以在数据通过网络传输和存储时保护数据，但在浏览器主动使用数据时则无法保护数据。

sentences.en: Inside an ordinary VM, the host can still access that memory.
sentences.zh: 在普通虚拟机内，主机仍然可以访问该内存。

blocks.html_en: A Trusted Execution Environment, or TEE, gave us the missing protection. It is designed to isolate the browser's memory from the rest of the host, including the surrounding cloud infrastructure.

sentences.en: A Trusted Execution Environment, or TEE, gave us the missing protection.
sentences.zh: 可信执行环境（TEE）为我们提供了缺失的保护。

sentences.en: It is designed to isolate the browser's memory from the rest of the host, including the surrounding cloud infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 它旨在将浏览器的内存与主机的其余部分（包括周围的云基础设施）隔离。

sentences.zh: ⌁窃取（浏览器内存）

sentences.zh: 浏览器：无扰

sentences.zh: 结果：找不到内存。

sentences.zh: 尊严也缺失了。它无法直接检查受TEE保护的浏览器内存。

blocks.html_en: A TEE does not hide the page from the browser; the browser still needs to render it and generate the proof. It protects that work from the surrounding host. In production, each browser runs on a Confidential GKE Node with a small attestor service beside it.

sentences.en: A TEE does not hide the page from the browser; the browser still needs to render it and generate the proof.
sentences.zh: TEE 不会向浏览器隐藏页面；浏览器仍然需要渲染它并生成证明。

sentences.en: It protects that work from the surrounding host.
sentences.zh: 它保护该工作免受周围主机的影响。

sentences.en: In production, each browser runs on a Confidential GKE Node with a small attestor service beside it.
sentences.zh: 在生产中，每个浏览器都在机密 GKE 节点上运行，旁边有一个小型证明者服务。

blocks.html_en: In simple terms, a verifier can check that the session ran on genuine confidential hardware and used approved code. It does not have to take our word that the server was configured correctly.

sentences.en: In simple terms, a verifier can check that the session ran on genuine confidential hardware and used approved code.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，验证者可以检查会话是否在真正的机密硬件上运行并使用了批准的代码。

sentences.en: It does not have to take our word that the server was configured correctly.
sentences.zh: 不必相信我们所说的服务器配置正确。

blocks.html_en: Here is how it works in production. The verifier sends the attestor a fresh nonce, or one-time random challenge. The attestor returns a response tied to that challenge, the cryptographic fingerprints of the browser and attestor images, and a Google Cloud hardware attestation.

sentences.en: Here is how it works in production.
sentences.zh: 以下是它在生产中的工作原理。

sentences.en: The verifier sends the attestor a fresh nonce, or one-time random challenge.
sentences.zh: 验证者向证明者发送一个新的随机数，或一次性随机挑战。

sentences.en: The attestor returns a response tied to that challenge, the cryptographic fingerprints of the browser and attestor images, and a Google Cloud hardware attestation.
sentences.zh: 证明者返回与该挑战相关的响应、浏览器和证明者图像的加密指纹以及 Google Cloud 硬件证明。

blocks.html_en: A TEE still does not replace TLS, authentication, authorization, or code review; it narrows what must be trusted.

sentences.en: A TEE still does not replace TLS, authentication, authorization, or code review; it narrows what must be trusted.
sentences.zh: TEE 仍然不能取代 TLS、身份验证、授权或代码审查；它缩小了必须信任的范围。

blocks.html_en: This was not a security feature we could bolt on after the browser worked. TEE availability now determined where we could run Popcorn.

sentences.en: This was not a security feature we could bolt on after the browser worked.
sentences.zh: 这不是浏览器工作后我们可以附加的安全功能。

sentences.en: TEE availability now determined where we could run Popcorn.
sentences.zh: TEE 的可用性现在决定了我们可以在哪里运行 Popcorn。

blocks.html_en: We first self-hosted on AWS with AMD SEV-SNP, but too few nearby regions supported it. Google Cloud offered AMD SEV-backed Confidential VMs and Confidential GKE in more of the regions we needed, so we moved the fleet.

sentences.en: We first self-hosted on AWS with AMD SEV-SNP, but too few nearby regions supported it.
sentences.zh: 我们首先使用 AMD SEV-SNP 在 AWS 上进行自托管，但支持它的附近区域太少了。

sentences.en: Google Cloud offered AMD SEV-backed Confidential VMs and Confidential GKE in more of the regions we needed, so we moved the fleet.
sentences.zh: Google Cloud 在我们需要的更多区域提供了 AMD SEV 支持的机密虚拟机和机密 GKE，因此我们迁移了机群。

blocks.html_en: The browser was only half the system

sentences.en: The browser was only half the system
sentences.zh: 浏览器只是系统的一半

blocks.html_en: At this point, we had a browser image that could run inside a TEE. But an image is not a browser cloud. We still needed a system that could:

sentences.en: At this point, we had a browser image that could run inside a TEE.
sentences.zh: 此时，我们有了一个可以在 TEE 内运行的浏览器映像。

sentences.en: But an image is not a browser cloud.
sentences.zh: 但图像不是浏览器云。

sentences.en: We still needed a system that could:
sentences.zh: 我们仍然需要一个能够：

blocks.html_en: • keep isolated browsers ready before users asked for them;

sentences.en: keep isolated browsers ready before users asked for them;
sentences.zh: 在用户提出要求之前，让隔离的浏览器做好准备；

blocks.html_en: • route each request to a nearby, healthy region;

sentences.en: route each request to a nearby, healthy region;
sentences.zh: 将每个请求路由到附近的健康区域；

blocks.html_en: • connect the user securely to the assigned browser; and

sentences.en: connect the user securely to the assigned browser; and
sentences.zh: 将用户安全地连接到指定的浏览器；和

blocks.html_en: • replace used browsers, add TEE machines when needed, and clean up finished sessions.

sentences.en: replace used browsers, add TEE machines when needed, and clean up finished sessions.
sentences.zh: 更换使用过的浏览器，在需要时添加 TEE 机器，并清理已完成的会话。

blocks.html_en: We split the work across a few focused components. The control plane authenticates the request and selects a region. A pool manager in that region assigns a ready browser, while the gateway securely carries the live view between the user and that browser. The control plane coordinates the session without sitting in the streaming path.

sentences.en: We split the work across a few focused components.
sentences.zh: 我们将工作分为几个重点组成部分。

sentences.en: The control plane authenticates the request and selects a region.
sentences.zh: 控制平面验证请求并选择区域。

sentences.en: A pool manager in that region assigns a ready browser, while the gateway securely carries the live view between the user and that browser.
sentences.zh: 该区域的池管理器会分配一个就绪的浏览器，而网关则安全地在用户和该浏览器之间传输实时视图。

sentences.en: The control plane coordinates the session without sitting in the streaming path.
sentences.zh: 控制平面无需位于流路径中即可协调会话。

blocks.html_en: Agones is an open-source system for managing fleets of multiplayer game servers on Kubernetes. That sounds unrelated until you look at the lifecycle. A browser waits for a user, belongs to that user for a short session, and is then discarded. Agones already knows how to manage that pattern.

sentences.en: Agones is an open-source system for managing fleets of multiplayer game servers on Kubernetes.
sentences.zh: Agones 是一个开源系统，用于管理 Kubernetes 上的多人游戏服务器群。

sentences.en: That sounds unrelated until you look at the lifecycle.
sentences.zh: 在您查看生命周期之前，这听起来无关紧要。

sentences.en: A browser waits for a user, belongs to that user for a short session, and is then discarded.
sentences.zh: 浏览器等待用户，属于该用户一段短暂的会话，然后被丢弃。

sentences.en: Agones already knows how to manage that pattern.
sentences.zh: Agones 已经知道如何管理这种模式。

blocks.html_en: Each regional pool keeps a warm buffer of browsers that are already running and marked Ready. A request only needs to claim one, so scheduling, image pulls, and browser startup stay off the user-facing path. Agones tracks each browser from waiting to assigned to finished. When one is assigned, its FleetAutoscaler starts a replacement. If the current TEE machines are full, our node prescaler adds another machine.

sentences.en: Each regional pool keeps a warm buffer of browsers that are already running and marked Ready.
sentences.zh: 每个区域池都会保留一个已运行并标记为“就绪”的浏览器的热缓冲区。

sentences.en: A request only needs to claim one, so scheduling, image pulls, and browser startup stay off the user-facing path.
sentences.zh: 一个请求只需要声明一个，因此调度、图像拉取和浏览器启动就不会出现在面向用户的路径上。

sentences.en: Agones tracks each browser from waiting to assigned to finished.
sentences.zh: Agones 跟踪每个浏览器从等待到分配到完成的整个过程。

sentences.en: When one is assigned, its FleetAutoscaler starts a replacement.
sentences.zh: 当一个被分配时，它的 FleetAutoscaler 开始替换。

sentences.en: If the current TEE machines are full, our node prescaler adds another machine.
sentences.zh: 如果当前 TEE 机器已满，我们的节点预分频器会添加另一台机器。

blocks.html_en: The flow is simple: a user starts a session, and the control plane chooses a pool close to them. Each regional pool contains several TEE nodes, and each node runs many isolated browser pods. The pool manager asks Agones for a ready browser and returns signed connection details. The live view then travels through the regional gateway directly to that browser. Behind the scenes, the scalers replace the assigned pod and add another TEE node when the pool needs more room.

sentences.en: The flow is simple: a user starts a session, and the control plane chooses a pool close to them.
sentences.zh: 流程很简单：用户启动会话，控制平面选择靠近他们的池。

sentences.en: Each regional pool contains several TEE nodes, and each node runs many isolated browser pods.
sentences.zh: 每个区域池包含多个 TEE 节点，每个节点运行许多独立的浏览器 Pod。

sentences.en: The pool manager asks Agones for a ready browser and returns signed connection details.
sentences.zh: 池管理器向 Agones 请求准备好的浏览器并返回签名的连接详细信息。

sentences.en: The live view then travels through the regional gateway directly to that browser.
sentences.zh: 然后，实时视图通过区域网关直接传输到该浏览器。

sentences.en: Behind the scenes, the scalers replace the assigned pod and add another TEE node when the pool needs more room.
sentences.zh: 在幕后，缩放器会替换分配的 Pod，并在池需要更多空间时添加另一个 TEE 节点。

blocks.html_en: Together, these pieces gave us a repeatable way to bring up a secure browser cluster in a new region, keep browsers ready, and serve users from a location close to them.

sentences.en: Together, these pieces gave us a repeatable way to bring up a secure browser cluster in a new region, keep browsers ready, and serve users from a location close to them.

blocks.html_en: Once the secure regional fleet was running, our focus shifted from where the browser ran to how it felt. Phones and slow networks exposed rough edges in the live stream, runtime, and viewer. We worked through them one by one.

sentences.en: Once the secure regional fleet was running, our focus shifted from where the browser ran to how it felt.
sentences.zh: 一旦安全区域机群开始运行，我们的重点就从浏览器运行的位置转移到它的感觉。

sentences.en: Phones and slow networks exposed rough edges in the live stream, runtime, and viewer.
sentences.zh: 电话和慢速网络暴露了直播、运行时间和观众的粗糙边缘。

sentences.en: We worked through them one by one.
sentences.zh: 我们一一研究了它们。

sentences.en: From WebRTC to VNC
sentences.zh: 从 WebRTC 到 VNC

blocks.html_en: The first major change was the live view. In our iOS testing, Low Power Mode sometimes prevented the remote video from autoplaying, while backgrounding the app could lead to slow ICE reconnection. Some mobile and corporate networks also blocked or degraded WebRTC's preferred UDP paths. TURN, including relay over TCP, improved reachability but added another network hop and, in our measurements, more latency.

sentences.en: The first major change was the live view.
sentences.zh: 第一个重大变化是实时取景。

sentences.en: In our iOS testing, Low Power Mode sometimes prevented the remote video from autoplaying, while backgrounding the app could lead to slow ICE reconnection.
sentences.zh: 在我们的 iOS 测试中，低功耗模式有时会阻止远程视频自动播放，而后台应用程序可能会导致 ICE 重新连接速度缓慢。

sentences.en: Some mobile and corporate networks also blocked or degraded WebRTC's preferred UDP paths.
sentences.zh: 一些移动和企业网络还阻止或降低了 WebRTC 的首选 UDP 路径。

sentences.en: TURN, including relay over TCP, improved reachability but added another network hop and, in our measurements, more latency.
sentences.zh: TURN，包括通过 TCP 的中继，提高了可达性，但增加了另一个网络跃点，并且在我们的测量中，增加了延迟。

blocks.html_en: We replaced the WebRTC video stream with VNC's Remote Framebuffer protocol, carried over a secure WebSocket and rendered with noVNC. RFB represents display updates as rectangles, which suited our mostly static verification pages: users often pause to read or type, so the display changes only intermittently. This is a workload-specific trade-off; WebRTC remains better suited to high-motion content.

sentences.en: RFB represents display updates as rectangles, which suited our mostly static verification pages: users often pause to read or type, so the display changes only intermittently.

sentences.en: For Popcorn, the change reduced the live-view path to one WebSocket connection, shortened recovery after app switches, and produced more predictable behavior on slow mobile and corporate networks.

content_html_zh:
阿卜杜勒·拉希德·雷沙姆瓦拉

Aug 5, 2026

工程爆米花TEE

Reclaim 可以让人们从他们已经使用的网站上证明自己的事实。 Popcorn 是我们构建的可证明浏览器云，旨在使这些证明更易于集成。 用户在可信执行环境 (TEE) 内运行的实时移动原生浏览器中完成流程。 Popcorn 生成证明，然后销毁会话。 您可以尝试 Popcorn 或探索 GitHub 上的代码。

在最近的 30 天窗口中，Popcorn 创建了 102,859 个浏览器会话，并在 p50 的 470 毫秒和 p95 的 889 毫秒内分配了就绪的浏览器。

故事从用户手机上的 WebView 开始。 这种方法使工作更贴近用户，但它要求每个集成 Reclaim 的应用程序在其口袋中携带数量惊人的基础设施：本机加密、WebView 编排、证明生成和特定于平台的粘合。 我们重建了证明生成引擎，并将证明时间从大约 40 秒缩短到 4-5 秒，但集成度仍然很高。 这次迁徙本身就是一个故事。

性能问题得到改善。 整合问题却没有。

我们构建了 App Clip 和 Android Instant App，以避免完整的 SDK 集成。 它们有效，但合作伙伴不希望验证将用户带入单独的应用程序体验。 Google Play Instant 最终被终止。 我们需要一种留在产品流程内部的集成，而不需要将完整的浏览器和证明工作负载放在手机上。

该产品的想法听起来几乎简单得令人怀疑：远程打开浏览器，将其实时视图传输给用户，让他们登录并导航，然后生成证明。 然而，将工作从电话上转移出去也会将信任模型中最困难的部分转移到我们的基础设施中。

从内核开始

我们评估了 Browserbase 和其他托管浏览器平台。 内核最适合我们的流程，特别是因为我们需要有头浏览器。

用户需要操作真实、可见的 Chrome 会话。 有些网站在无头模式下的行为有所不同，而有些登录流程会阻止自动化。 内核为我们提供了交互式 Chrome 会话、实时视图以及我们可以构建的浏览器控制 API。

内核很快就让我们得到了一个可以工作的产品。 另一个重要的一点是它的浏览器图像是开源的。 我们可以检查图像，进行所需的流程更改，并向上游提供有用的修复，包括父帧状态事件和视频同步反回声修复。

一旦远程浏览器体验发挥作用，更困难的问题就变成了浏览器可以在哪里安全运行。

内核没有计划支持我们所需的硬件支持的安全模型。 这意味着浏览器必须在我们控制的基础设施上运行。 我们开始构建自己的基于 TEE 的部署，使用 Kernel 的开源浏览器映像作为基础，而不是从头开始重建一个 headful Chromium 容器。

浏览器仍然必须被信任

浏览器会话处理凭据、cookie 和私人帐户数据。 加密可以在数据通过网络传输和存储时保护数据，但在浏览器主动使用数据时则无法保护数据。 在普通虚拟机内，主机仍然可以访问该内存。

可信执行环境（TEE）为我们提供了缺失的保护。 它旨在将浏览器的内存与主机的其余部分（包括周围的云基础设施）隔离。

结果：找不到内存。 尊严也缺失了。它无法直接检查受TEE保护的浏览器内存。

TEE 不会向浏览器隐藏页面；浏览器仍然需要渲染它并生成证明。 它保护该工作免受周围主机的影响。 在生产中，每个浏览器都在机密 GKE 节点上运行，旁边有一个小型证明者服务。

简而言之，验证者可以检查会话是否在真正的机密硬件上运行并使用了批准的代码。 不必相信我们所说的服务器配置正确。

以下是它在生产中的工作原理。 验证者向证明者发送一个新的随机数，或一次性随机挑战。 证明者返回与该挑战相关的响应、浏览器和证明者图像的加密指纹以及 Google Cloud 硬件证明。

TEE 仍然不能取代 TLS、身份验证、授权或代码审查；它缩小了必须信任的范围。

这不是浏览器工作后我们可以附加的安全功能。 TEE 的可用性现在决定了我们可以在哪里运行 Popcorn。

我们首先使用 AMD SEV-SNP 在 AWS 上进行自托管，但支持它的附近区域太少了。 Google Cloud 在我们需要的更多区域提供了 AMD SEV 支持的机密虚拟机和机密 GKE，因此我们迁移了机群。

浏览器只是系统的一半

此时，我们有了一个可以在 TEE 内运行的浏览器映像。 但图像不是浏览器云。 我们仍然需要一个能够：

  • 在用户提出要求之前，让隔离的浏览器做好准备；
  • 将每个请求路由到附近的健康区域；
  • 将用户安全地连接到指定的浏览器；和
  • 更换使用过的浏览器，在需要时添加 TEE 机器，并清理已完成的会话。

我们将工作分为几个重点组成部分。 控制平面验证请求并选择区域。 该区域的池管理器会分配一个就绪的浏览器，而网关则安全地在用户和该浏览器之间传输实时视图。 控制平面无需位于流路径中即可协调会话。

Agones 是一个开源系统，用于管理 Kubernetes 上的多人游戏服务器群。 在您查看生命周期之前，这听起来无关紧要。 浏览器等待用户，属于该用户一段短暂的会话，然后被丢弃。 Agones 已经知道如何管理这种模式。

每个区域池都会保留一个已运行并标记为“就绪”的浏览器的热缓冲区。 一个请求只需要声明一个，因此调度、图像拉取和浏览器启动就不会出现在面向用户的路径上。 Agones 跟踪每个浏览器从等待到分配到完成的整个过程。 当一个被分配时，它的 FleetAutoscaler 开始替换。 如果当前 TEE 机器已满，我们的节点预分频器会添加另一台机器。

流程很简单：用户启动会话，控制平面选择靠近他们的池。 每个区域池包含多个 TEE 节点，每个节点运行许多独立的浏览器 Pod。 池管理器向 Agones 请求准备好的浏览器并返回签名的连接详细信息。 然后，实时视图通过区域网关直接传输到该浏览器。 在幕后，缩放器会替换分配的 Pod，并在池需要更多空间时添加另一个 TEE 节点。

从 WebRTC 到 VNC

第一个重大变化是实时取景。 在我们的 iOS 测试中，低功耗模式有时会阻止远程视频自动播放，而后台应用程序可能会导致 ICE 重新连接速度缓慢。 一些移动和企业网络还阻止或降低了 WebRTC 的首选 UDP 路径。 TURN，包括通过 TCP 的中继，提高了可达性，但增加了另一个网络跃点，并且在我们的测量中，增加了延迟。

我们用 VNC 的远程帧缓冲协议替换了 WebRTC 视频流，通过安全的 WebSocket 进行传输并使用 noVNC 进行渲染。 RFB 将显示更新表示为矩形，这适合我们大多数静态验证页面：用户经常暂停阅读或打字，因此显示仅间歇性变化。 这是一个特定于工作负载的权衡； WebRTC 仍然更适合高动态内容。

我们学到了什么

开始管理。 当需求变得尖锐时进行分叉。 学习后专攻。

通往爆米花的道路不是“建造还是购买”。 使用内核让我们可以在构建浏览器基础设施之前验证产品。 分叉其开源形象告诉我们堆栈的哪些部分很重要。 操作该分叉暴露了通用映像对我们工作负载的限制。 直到那时，最小的图像、移动原生查看器和我们自己的缩放器才成为明智的选择。

让真正的约束选择技术。

与时尚相比，云区域、移动网络和手机键盘更多地选择了这种架构。 每个更改都来自于观察验证流程在实际约束下失败，然后在拥有它的层修复该约束。

安全成为基础设施拓扑。

一旦每个浏览器都必须在 TEE 内运行，机密计算的可用性就成为调度的一部分。 它决定了云选择、区域扩展、节点池、图像、证明、容量规划和故障处理。 安全需求不再停留在安全层。

Popcorn 现在为应用程序提供了一种更轻松的方式来集成 Reclaim，同时将敏感的浏览器工作负载保持在可证明的环境中。 它需要托管服务、开源分支、云迁移、新的流媒体路径以及对移动键盘的过度关注才能实现这一目标。 运行时映像、队列配置、证明设计和完整存储库都是开源的。
